QUOTE: A repo's own `index_scope:` declaration wins if it has one. Otherwise the scope is the whole repository... absent → None → fall through; present but unusable → _Rejected → whole-repo, with the reason recorded

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a declared index_scope wins, and that absent, unusable, or no-usable-root cases all fall back to indexing the whole repo.
